quotes.text: Bug 1882574 renamed msgIOAuth2Module.initFromSmtp to initFromOutgoing and changed OAuth2Module to read the generic server URI and legacy prefs. SmtpAuthenticator still called initFromSmtp. A follow-up two days later changed that call to initFromOutgoing, fixing the missed OAuth2 SMTP authentication path. Trace consumers of a renamed XPCOM method, including runtime paths that compile or lint without exposing the error. The accepted follow-up is D210038.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
